lastCompletedStory.title: Compute next version (0.x convention) and atomically write version.ts + package.json

nextStoryContext: US-002 created src/release/version.ts exporting computeNextVersion(current, bump) and two pure text-transform writers: applyVersionToVersionTs(text, newVersion) and applyVersionToPackageJson(text, newVersion). US-003 (or whichever story reads next) should import from 'src/release/version.ts'. The 0.x demotion (major->minor for pre-1.0) lives exclusively in computeNextVersion. The two writer functions are DI-friendly pure transforms (no real fs); callers supply the file text and receive the updated text back.

officialDocsValidated.summary: src/release/version.ts imports only the project-internal bump.ts (BumpLevel type). No external npm library was used; no fetch needed.
